title: Ulyana and the Vector
author: Silas Okonkwo
blurb: Theo Voss, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
